purpose: LAVQ on Cosmos-Policy-LIBERO-Predict2-2B at W2 and W3: (1) reader metric on the future slots of the joint denoising state at the reader cut, (2) future-aware bit allocation by measured group exchanges, (3) trellis-coded (QTIP) rounding at K = 1..4, (4) shared-table calibration on A + lam_M Z_M + beta K; held-out gates, then the LIBERO-Plus closed loop (panels A+B+C, 840) paired with the Cosmos A16 baselines.

cosmos.runtime: cosmos_runtime.CosmosRuntime (arm bf16) of cosmos-policy-c8-w4a4, as the A16 baselines; arms overwrite the 280 target Linear weights in place
cosmos.endpoint: endpoint.run_endpoint of cosmos-policy-c8-w4a4 (the official five-evaluation res_multistep sampler with the no_grad boundaries removed), grad_enabled for every LAVQ query so staged and replayed queries share one path

panels.seeds: CosmosRuntime.episode: env seed 800000000 + 1000*index, sampler seed 900000000 + 1000*index + replan (same as the A16 baselines)

qtip.rule: ravq_qtip.quantize_layer (the baselines' QTIP port with K widened to 1..4) on the baselines' BF16 masters and C80 Hessians, seed seed_base + layer index (the baselines' per-layer seeds); K = 2 / 3 are the baselines' QTIP_W2 / QTIP_W3 with their native trellis codes

reader.cut_rule: the cut whose future swap removes the largest share of the action error (future share rho, C80, mean of QTIP_W2 and QTIP_W3); exact ties go to the earlier cut
reader.definition: z = the future-image slots (6, 7) of the solver state just before the cut-th denoiser evaluation; R = the remaining solver steps and the final denoise from that state; the BF16 reader keeps the teacher's other slots and multistep history, the swap (rho) keeps the student's

errors.A: mean squared error of the 16 x 6 motor actions (the executed chunk, unnormalized), gripper reported apart
errors.Z: |z_S - z_T|^2 / |z_T|^2 on the future slots of the cut state
errors.K: soft-bin KL(BF16 reader at z_T || BF16 reader at z_S) over the 16 x 6 normalized motor actions, C80 per-channel mean / std
errors.rho: 1 - sum |R_S(z_T) - a_T|^2 / sum |a_S - a_T|^2 over the panel (16 x 6 motor), R_S the student's own remaining steps

loss.rule: lambda = rho mean A / mean Z and beta = beta_fraction lambda mean Z / mean K on C80 at the coefficient arm (the Fast-WAM loss-pair rule), fixed for both bit widths; lam_M = lambda mean Z / mean Z_M at each family's base

allocation.rule: per group g: gain = L(base) - L(g up one bit), cost = L(g down one bit) - L(base) on C80 with L = A + lam_M Z_M + beta K; donors by cost per freed bit (ascending), receivers by gain per added bit (descending, gain > 0); exchange j lowers donor j as a whole and spends its bits on receiver layers (receiver groups in order, inside a group by H-proxy reduction per added bit, a layer that does not fit is skipped); a donor is taken only while its cost density is below the gain density of the receiver it funds and it has received nothing; prefixes 0..J are measured on C80 and the one with the lowest L is the allocation (prefix 0 = the uniform host)

gates.lavqu: held-out L(LAVQU_Wb) <= L(QTIP_Wb), otherwise the family's allocation falls back to prefix 0
gates.calibrated: held-out L(LAVQ_Wb) <= L(LAVQU_Wb) (the Fast-WAM rule), otherwise the loop runs the uncalibrated arm
gates.loop: the chosen arm of a family runs the closed loop unless its weights are the uniform host's (then the host's loop is the result)

training.roles: self / cross / mlp (allocation.types), one [512, 2] table offset per (role, K)
training.update: delta u = -eta g_u / max|g_u| with u = table entry / rms(tlut) over live entries (ravqc v3); folded from the FP32 decode of the codes

pipeline.name: lavq1
pipeline.time_basis: quant K=1 and K=4 of 280 layers ~0.7 GPU-h each (baselines' QTIP W2 0.70 GPU-h; the Viterbi cost does not depend on K) -> ~0.7 h on 2 GPUs; teacher / cut / metric ~20 min; sensitivity 38 arms x 80 C80 queries ~0.5 s + BF16 reader reads ~45 min GPU; prefixes + held-out ~30 min GPU; calibration ~40 min per arm, one arm per GPU: ~3 h wall

smoke.name: lavqs
smoke.time_basis: every stage after quant on 2 C80 + 2 held-out contexts (38 sensitivity arms x 2 queries, 2 calibration updates); < 1 h on 2 GPUs, gdev (walltime <= 2 h)

loop.name: lavql
loop.time_basis: up to 2 arms x 840 episodes; the A16 baselines ran 6160 episodes on 20 slots in 6 h 47 min (~900 per hour) -> ~2 h plus startup
